affected_component: Deterministic upstream conformance node selection (admitted test surface)
invariant: The upstream conformance selector's admitted test surface must equal what pytest itself would collect for the pinned upstream: the upstream's declared testpaths/python_files when present, otherwise pytest's default basename patterns over the whole tree minus norecursedirs. Package-internal tests directories and non-default basenames are executable under the base-pytest profile via explicit node ids, so excluding them silently removed the upstream conformance evidence lane from otherwise qualified cases. Runner profile constraints (async exclusion, marks, fixture ranking) are unchanged, and zero relevant nodes is still reported as EMPTY.
